title: Sanitized iRacing variable-table inventory
description: Simulator capability metadata captured from a live iRacing variable table. Carries no telemetry values and no participant identifiers. It is a point-in-time snapshot of one simulator build in one session, never eternal simulator truth, and it supports no scientific finding.

values_sampled.description: Apex Labs accepts metadata-only inventories. An inventory that sampled values is refused, not filtered.

direct_identifiers_included.description: An inventory declaring direct identifiers is refused outright.

count.description: Array element count. 1 is a scalar; 6 marks a 360 Hz sub-sample channel; 72 marks a per-car array.

unit.description: SDK unit token. A value beginning with 'irsdk_' names an enumeration or bitfield whose value dictionary this inventory does NOT carry.
